label: Fire HD 10 (13th gen) tablet
description: Amazon Fire HD 10 (13th generation, 2023) — 10.1-inch budget tablet, Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac) only, no cellular; USB-C 2.0 charge/data port with no Ethernet support.
notes: Wi-Fi 5 (802.11ac, 2x2, 2.4/5 GHz) — no Wi-Fi 6, no 6 GHz. Cellular: none at all, so no wwan0. USB-C is USB 2.0 and Fire OS provides no Ethernet interface, so no usb0: this endpoint is wireless-only and will lose connectivity if the SSID disappears. Fire OS is Android-based but locked down; expect no 802.1X EAP-TLS and no WPA3-SAE on older builds.
